$schema-note: memory-vocabulary.json — the project-owned AREA + TAG vocabulary for gobbi's memory standard (skills/memory/rules.md §1.5 area allowlists + §2.5 tag vocabulary). De-hardcoded out of skills/memory/scripts/validate-frontmatter.sh so the harness is project-general: a non-gobbi project ships its own copy of this file and the same validator reads it via jq. The validator reads the materialized 'effective.*' lists; 'universal' and 'project' document how each effective list is composed (universal base ∪ project additions). Source of the gobbi values: validate-frontmatter.sh (AREA_SPINE/AREA_MISTAKES/TAG_VOCAB) + rules.md §1.5/§2.5 at develop@7ef21bf5. GAP-1 decision: jq is an accepted repo dependency (precedent: hooks/session-end.sh reads session.json via jq).

universal.$note: The cross-project-generic baseline — areas and tags any software project's memory would plausibly use. A fresh non-gobbi project starts from this base and adds its own project-specific vocabulary. The universal areas include the ratified additions docs/tooling/tests (spine) and the assumption trap-class (mistakes); the universal _shared bucket is the cross-cutting no-match destination.

project.$note: gobbi-specific vocabulary layered on top of the universal base. These name gobbi's own workflow steps (ideation/preparation/planning/execution/wrap-up/evaluation), runtimes (codex/hooks), subsystems (memory/workflow/wrap-up), and idioms (rename-sweep/vocabulary-sweep). A non-gobbi project replaces this whole block with its own.

effective.$note: The materialized vocabulary the validator enforces = universal ∪ project. These are the closed allowlists. Round-trip guarantee: gobbi's effective lists are a SUPERSET of gobbi's pre-de-hardcoding values (validate-frontmatter.sh AREA_SPINE/AREA_MISTAKES/TAG_VOCAB at develop@7ef21bf5), so NO currently-valid file becomes invalid. The validator reads ONLY these three arrays.

tagAreaMap.$note: The TOTAL deterministic tag→area selection map (rules.md §1.5). Priority-ordered: the FIRST entry whose any 'tags' is present on the record wins. 'area' is the resolved area; 'tags' are the trigger tags. Used by both the write-time agent and Wrap-up routing. _shared is the no-match fallback (never listed here). Feature-dir inputs are normalized via featureDirNormalization FIRST.

featureDirNormalization.$note: When the selector input is a feature-dir name (a spine record promoted up from a feature), normalize it to a spine area FIRST, then match in the spine map.
